title: v2 export must preserve Dashboard datasource (SHARED_DASHBOARD_QUERY) references
answers: Why does a reused panel show Random Walk data after importing an exported dashboard?
Exported v2 dashboard loses '-- Dashboard --' datasource reference
Panel that reuses another panel's results breaks after export/import
How should the Dashboard datasource be handled during dashboard export?
body:
Symptom: after exporting a v2 dashboard ('Share dashboard with another instance') and reimporting, a panel that reused another panel's query results instead shows Grafana's built-in Random Walk data.
Root cause: makeExportableV2 in exporters.ts treated the stable `-- Dashboard --` datasource reference (SHARED_DASHBOARD_QUERY) as if it were an instance-specific datasource UID, anonymizing/remapping it like any other datasource.
Fix pattern: before generating export labels or stripping/remapping a query's datasource UID, check if it equals SHARED_DASHBOARD_QUERY and return early, leaving the reference untouched.
Constraints: applies only to this exact built-in '-- Dashboard --' reference; other built-in datasources (e.g. grafana/testdata), ordinary datasource anonymization, migrations, and runtime datasource resolution must keep their existing behavior unchanged.
applies: public/app/features/dashboard-scene/scene/export/exporters.ts — v2 dashboard export (makeExportableV2), including library panels inlined for external export
says: Reused panel shows Random Walk after dashboard export
Dashboard query reference lost on export and import
Panel fetching from another panel breaks after import
Shared dashboard data source replaced during export
Dashboard to instance copy loses panel query links
search: v2 dashboard export in makeExportableV2 (public/app/features/dashboard-scene/scene/export/exporters.ts) must check if a query's datasource UID equals SHARED_DASHBOARD_QUERY (public/app/plugins/datasource/dashboard/constants.ts) and skip anonymization/remapping for it, leaving the '-- Dashboard --' reference untouched. Failing to preserve this stable built-in reference causes reimported dashboards to show Random Walk data instead of shared panel query results. This constraint applies only to the SHARED_DASHBOARD_QUERY reference itself; all other datasource anonymization, built-in datasources (testdata), migrations, and runtime resolution keep existing behavior unchanged.
